description: Implementation of Zephyr RTOS abstraction layer functions, including thread, mutex, semaphore, event, queue, timer, and time management.

methods.name: cy_rtos_last_error
methods.description: Returns the last error status stored internally.

methods.name: error_converter
methods.description: Converts internal Zephyr error codes to external cy_rslt_t codes and updates last error.

methods.name: free_thead_obj
methods.description: Frees allocated thread object and its stack buffer.

methods.name: thread_entry_function_wrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for thread entry function to match Zephyr thread creation signature.

methods.name: cy_rtos_create_thread
methods.description: Creates a new thread with specified parameters.

methods.name: cy_rtos_exit_thread
methods.description: Exits the current thread.

methods.name: cy_rtos_terminate_thread
methods.description: Terminates a specified thread.

methods.name: cy_rtos_is_thread_running
methods.description: Checks if a thread is currently running.

methods.name: cy_rtos_get_thread_state
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a thread.

methods.name: cy_rtos_join_thread
methods.description: Waits for a thread to finish execution.

methods.name: cy_rtos_get_thread_handle
methods.description: Gets the handle of the current thread.

methods.name: cy_rtos_wait_thread_notification
methods.description: Waits for thread notification with optional timeout.

methods.name: cy_rtos_thread_set_notification
methods.description: Wakes up a thread.

methods.name: cy_rtos_init_mutex2
methods.description: Initializes a mutex (non-recursive, as recursive not supported).

methods.name: cy_rtos_get_mutex
methods.description: Locks a mutex with optional timeout.

methods.name: cy_rtos_set_mutex
methods.description: Unlocks a mutex.

methods.name: cy_rtos_deinit_mutex
methods.description: Deinitializes a mutex.

methods.name: cy_rtos_init_semaphore
methods.description: Initializes a semaphore with max and initial count.

methods.name: cy_rtos_get_semaphore
methods.description: Acquires a semaphore with optional timeout.

methods.name: cy_rtos_set_semaphore
methods.description: Releases a semaphore.

methods.name: cy_rtos_get_count_semaphore
methods.description: Gets current count of semaphore.

methods.name: cy_rtos_deinit_semaphore
methods.description: Resets a semaphore.

methods.name: cy_rtos_init_event
methods.description: Initializes an event object.

methods.name: cy_rtos_setbits_event
methods.description: Sets bits in an event.

methods.name: cy_rtos_clearbits_event
methods.description: Clears bits in an event.

methods.name: cy_rtos_getbits_event
methods.description: Retrieves current bits of an event.

methods.name: cy_rtos_waitbits_event
methods.description: Waits for specific bits in an event, with options for all/any and clear.

methods.name: cy_rtos_deinit_event
methods.description: Deinitializes an event.

methods.name: cy_rtos_init_queue
methods.description: Initializes a message queue.

methods.name: cy_rtos_put_queue
methods.description: Puts an item into a message queue.

methods.name: cy_rtos_get_queue
methods.description: Retrieves an item from a message queue.

methods.name: cy_rtos_count_queue
methods.description: Gets number of used messages in queue.

methods.name: cy_rtos_space_queue
methods.description: Gets free space in queue.

methods.name: cy_rtos_reset_queue
methods.description: Resets a message queue.

methods.name: cy_rtos_deinit_queue
methods.description: Deinitializes a message queue.

methods.name: zephyr_timer_event_handler
methods.description: Timer callback handler that invokes user callback.

methods.name: cy_rtos_init_timer
methods.description: Initializes a timer with callback and trigger type.

methods.name: cy_rtos_start_timer
methods.description: Starts a timer with specified duration.

methods.name: cy_rtos_stop_timer
methods.description: Stops a timer.

methods.name: cy_rtos_is_running_timer
methods.description: Checks if a timer is active.

methods.name: cy_rtos_deinit_timer
methods.description: Deinitializes a timer, stopping it if running.

methods.name: cy_rtos_get_time
methods.description: Retrieves system uptime in milliseconds.

methods.name: cy_rtos_delay_milliseconds
methods.description: Delays execution for specified milliseconds.
